exchangeRate.source: European Central Bank euro foreign exchange reference rates
exchangeRate.formula: EUR/CNY divided by EUR/USD; USD list price multiplied by cross rate; rounded to CNY 0.01

caveats: Converted amounts are US-market reference prices, not prices in China.
US sales tax, cross-border shipping, import duties, and payment exchange costs are excluded.

The US Forza 60 TI product page itself does not identify a season; subsequent Rossignol Slovakia official e-shop evidence identifies the RAOPS01 + NX 12 KONECT package as Model 26/27, and the seed records that regional confirmation.

Binding configuration follows the official product page: Soul 102 and Hero Master LT R22 are skis without bindings; Hero Elite LT TI is listed as a system ski with a selectable SPX 14 KONECT GW binding; Forza 60 TI is listed as a system ski with selectable no-binding or SPX 12 KONECT GW configurations. Check the selected option at checkout.
